input.subject: Re: This weekend's showings
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

Thanks so much for setting those up on Saturday. We loved the light in the second one but the kitchen felt tight for us. My husband is still hung up on having a real dining area.

Are you around this week to talk through what's realistic in our range? We're flexible on the exact block, just want to stay close to the express train. And honestly after seeing a few in person I think we could stretch a little if the right thing came up.

No rush - just let me know what works for you.

Talk soon,
Priya
